title: A Periodic Orbit Trace Formula for Quantum Scrambling: The Role of the Normally Hyperbolic Invariant Manifold
summary: Out-of-Time-Order Correlators (OTOCs) quantify quantum information scrambling, but their connection to localized phase-space structures, such as chemical transition states, requires formal development. We derive a leading-order semiclassical expansion for the local microcanonical OTOC in systems with an index-1 saddle point, expressing the scrambling rate as a coherent sum over unstable periodic orbits on the Normally Hyperbolic Invariant Manifold (NHIM).
